title: Colonal Faces
description: Add Slime Face to your Chiseled Quartz!
body:
The Colonal Faces Resource Pack adds Colonals signature Slime face to Chiseled Quartz BLocks!

It is themed around Colonal's love of Pink Slime, and optimized for to be used in the [Colonal Mod Pack (CMP)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/colonal-pack).
